speaker: nora
headline: TRUST IS A SYSTEM PROPERTY.
deck: A public service is judged by the whole loop: signal, state response, feedback and outcome.
quote: Trust is not one promise. It is a system that keeps returning a usable answer.
facts: Front-end access is only one part of delivery.
Back-office state changes must be visible.
The outcome must close the loop for the user.
takeaway: A trustworthy institution makes the full system legible, not merely the launch moment.
